definitions.gloss: interior finishing material; interior trim material
definitions.explanation: Materials used to finish the inside of a building or vehicle, such as wall coverings, flooring, and ceiling panels, as distinct from structural or exterior materials.

examples.japanese: {内装材|ないそうざい}を{選|えら}ぶ。
{自然|しぜん}{素材|そざい}の{内装材|ないそうざい}が{人気|にんき}だ。
{部屋|へや}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}は{内装材|ないそうざい}の{色|いろ}や{質感|しつかん}で{大|おお}きく{変|か}わる。
examples.english: A room's atmosphere changes greatly depending on the color and texture of the interior materials.

notes:
Formed from {内装|ないそう} (interior fittings, interior decoration) + {材|ざい} (material). Used in construction, renovation, and car-customization contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内装材|ないそうざい}を{張|は}り{替|か}える: to replace the interior materials
- {木|き}の{内装材|ないそうざい}: wooden interior materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外装材|がいそうざい}: exterior material — the counterpart used for the outside of a building
- {建材|けんざい}: building material — a broader term covering all materials used in construction
